spans.s:
ubhá, a. both. [cf. ἄμφω, Lat. ambō, AS.
nom. fem. neut. bā, Goth. nom. neut. ba,
nom. masc. bai, w. dental extension, bajoϸs,
all meaning ‘both,’ Eng. bo-th: orig., perhaps,
 ‘couple,’ and akin w. √ubh.]

ubháya [525^4], a. of both sorts; both.
[ubhá.]

ubhayátas, adv. from both sides; in
both cases. [ubháya, acct !]

ubhayataḥ-sasya, n. having a crop
at both times, i. e. bearing two crops a
year.
